description:
Farm Titans 🌾🛰️ | Field Shift
We’re building a crop-rotation tool that turns NASA satellite data into clear, explainable advice farmers can use: protecting soil, saving water and adapting to a changing climate. We bring AI engineering, full-stack development and modern UX, and we aim to ship a polished, working product. Drought is already hurting Romanian farms, and we want to build something that outlives the weekend. Team complete, but happy to swap ideas!
